amos-bow.name: Amos' Bow
amos-bow.description: A longbow that was meticulously constructed by a fletcher from a faraway land. It was made with materials that are rarely seen in Teyvat, and it is adorned with intricate patterns.
amos-bow.passiveDescription: Increases Normal Attack and Aimed Shot DMG by {0}%. After a Normal or Aimed Shot is fired, DMG dealt increases by a further {1}% every 0.1s the arrow is in the air for up to 5 times.

skyward-harp.name: Skyward Harp
skyward-harp.description: A greatbow that symbolizes Dvalin's affiliation with the Anemo Archon. The sound of the bow firing is music to the Anemo Archon's ears. It contains the power of the sky and wind within.
skyward-harp.passiveDescription: Increases CRIT DMG by {0}%. Hits have a {1}% chance to inflict a small AoE attack, dealing 125% Physical ATK DMG. Can only occur once every {2}s.

rust.name: Rust
rust.description: A completely rusted iron greatbow. The average person would lack the strength to even lift it, let alone fire it.
rust.passiveDescription: Increases Normal Attack DMG by {0}% but decreases Charged Attack DMG by 10%.

AlleyHunter.name: Alley Hunter
AlleyHunter.description: An intricate, opulent longbow. It once belonged to a gentleman thief who was never caught.
AlleyHunter.passiveDescription: While the character equipped with this weapon is in the party but not on the field, their DMG increases by {0}% every second up to a max of {1}%. When the character is on the field for more than 4s, the aforementioned DMG buff decreases by {2}% per second until it reaches 0%.

AquaSimulacra.name: Aqua Simulacra
AquaSimulacra.description: This longbow's color is unpredictable. Under the light, it takes on a lustrous, watery blue.
AquaSimulacra.passiveDescription: HP is increased by {0}%. When there are opponents nearby, the DMG dealt by the wielder of this weapon is increased by {1}%. This will take effect whether the character is on-field or not.

AstralVulture'sCrimson.name: Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage
AstralVulture'sCrimson.description: An ancient longbow crested with red feathers, a sacred relic of the Flower-Feather Clan that has been passed down from generation to generation.
AstralVulture'sCrimson.passiveDescription: For 12s after triggering a Swirl reaction, ATK increases by {0}%. In addition, when 1/2 or more characters in the party are of a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the DMG dealt by the equipping character's Charged Attacks is increased by {1}% and Elemental Burst DMG dealt is increased by {2}%.
